stories.title: Patient registration with consent
stories.want: to create an account with my email, password and contact details
acceptance: Name, date of birth, email, phone, preferred language; optional emergency contact (encrypted)
Privacy policy consent required; electronic communications consent optional; consent version and date stored
Email address confirmed with a link
Only the minimum data is collected (justified in docs/data-classification.md)

stories.title: Login and secure sessions
stories.want: to log in and stay logged in safely
stories.so_that: I do not have to type my password at every action
acceptance: Access token valid at most 10 minutes
Refresh token in an httpOnly cookie, rotated at each use; reuse of an old token cancels all sessions
Logout revokes the session
Staff are logged out after 15 minutes of inactivity

stories.title: Strong password storage and password policy
stories.want: my password to be stored safely and to be refused if it is too weak
stories.so_that: a database leak does not expose my password
acceptance: Argon2id hashing
At least 12 characters, not containing the email
Wrong password and unknown email get the same answer (no user enumeration)

stories.title: Password reset without user enumeration
stories.want: to reset my password with a link sent by email
stories.so_that: I can get back into my account if I forget my password
acceptance: Request answers the same whether or not the email exists
Single-use reset link, valid a short time
All sessions are cancelled after a reset
Rate limited

stories.title: Mandatory two-factor authentication for staff
stories.want: to confirm my login with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app
stories.so_that: a stolen password alone cannot open patient data
acceptance: Mandatory for therapists, front desk and admin; optional for patients (later)
QR code enrolment at the first login; secret stored encrypted
Each code usable once
Staff endpoints refuse tokens without the MFA claim

stories.title: Role and care-relationship access control
stories.want: to open only the files of patients I treat
acceptance: Roles checked on every endpoint, role read from the database (done)
Ownership checks: patients see only their own data (done)
A therapist reads a patient file only with a care relationship (done)
Tests prove a therapist without care relationship cannot read another therapist's patient notes (done)

stories.title: Protection against password guessing
stories.want: logins to be limited and accounts locked after repeated failures
acceptance: 5 attempts per minute per IP on login, MFA and registration (429 above)
Account locked 15 minutes after 5 failures, with the same answer as a wrong password
Owner notified by email

stories.title: Break-the-glass emergency access
stories.want: to open a clinical file in an emergency with a mandatory reason
stories.so_that: care can continue when the therapist is unavailable
acceptance: Mandatory reason
Logged and flagged in the audit dashboard

stories.title: Service catalog
stories.want: to see the services with their duration, price and deposit
stories.so_that: I know what I book and what I pay
acceptance: Name in French and English, duration, price, deposit, description
Which therapists provide each service

stories.title: Therapist working hours and time off
stories.want: to set my weekly hours and my time off
stories.so_that: patients can only book when I am available
acceptance: Weekly hours per weekday, no overlap on the same day
Time off as date-time ranges; a therapist can delete only their own

stories.title: Bookable slot computation
stories.want: to see the free times for a service
stories.so_that: I can choose a time that suits me
acceptance: Free slots = hours - time off - appointments, on a 15-minute grid with a 5-minute buffer
No slots in the past or more than 60 days ahead
Tests cover end of day, overlapping time off and both daylight saving changes

stories.title: Rooms as a resource
stories.want: each appointment to also reserve a treatment room
stories.so_that: two treatments never share a room
acceptance: 4 rooms
Same no-overlap guarantee as therapists

stories.title: Therapist profile page
stories.want: to see each therapist's specialties, languages and photo
stories.so_that: I can choose who treats me
acceptance: Team page with names, specialties, languages, bio (done)
Photo (D2)

stories.title: Online booking with deposit
stories.want: to choose a service, a therapist (or first available), a date and a time, then pay the deposit
acceptance: Choose a service, a therapist (or first available), a date and a time, then pay the deposit: website (done)
Same on the mobile app (to do)
Confirmation shown (done) and sent by email (to do)

stories.title: No double booking under concurrency
stories.want: two patients never to get the same slot
acceptance: Database exclusion constraint (done)
30 simultaneous requests: 1 success; others get a clear 'slot no longer available' (HTTP 409) (done)

stories.title: Temporary hold during payment
stories.want: the slot to be held 10 minutes while I pay
stories.so_that: nobody takes it while I type my card
acceptance: Released automatically if payment is not completed

stories.title: Deposit payment confirmed by Stripe
stories.want: my booking to be confirmed only when the deposit is paid
stories.so_that: the clinic is protected against no-shows
acceptance: Stripe test mode
Signed, idempotent webhook; status pending_payment to confirmed

stories.title: Appointment lifecycle
stories.want: every status change to be recorded with who made it
stories.so_that: the clinic can explain what happened
acceptance: held, pending_payment, confirmed, checked_in, completed, cancelled_by_patient, cancelled_by_clinic, no_show, expired (done)
Transitions logged with the actor (done for booking, payment, cancel, reschedule, expiry; check-in and no-show with the front desk)

stories.title: Reschedule and cancel with the 24-hour rule
stories.want: to reschedule or cancel my appointment
acceptance: Cancel and reschedule more than 24 h before (done)
More than 24 h: deposit refunded through Stripe; less: kept as a fee (done)
Rule tested at the 24 h boundary, including across a DST change (done)

stories.title: Times shown in Montréal time
stories.want: every time to be shown in the clinic's time zone, also after a daylight saving change
stories.so_that: I never come at the wrong hour
acceptance: Stored in UTC, shown in America/Toronto
An appointment at 10:00 on the Monday after the November change shows 10:00

stories.title: Appointment reminders
stories.want: reminders 48 h and 24 h before my appointment
acceptance: Email and mobile push
No clinical information in the message

stories.title: Waiting list
stories.want: to be told if an earlier slot frees up
acceptance: Subscribe and unsubscribe
Notification when a matching slot frees up

stories.title: Insurance receipt
stories.want: an official PDF receipt after my appointment
stories.so_that: I can claim from my insurer
acceptance: Clinic info, therapist name and licence number, service, date, amount paid

stories.title: My patients and their history
stories.want: to see the list of my patients and each one's appointment history
acceptance: Only patients with a care relationship

stories.title: Encrypted SOAP session notes
stories.want: to write a SOAP note for a completed appointment
acceptance: Note encrypted by the application, key outside the database

stories.title: Signed notes and amendments
stories.want: notes to be locked once signed, with corrections as amendments
acceptance: Original kept; amendment linked to it

stories.title: Audit of clinical access
stories.want: every read and write of a note to be recorded
acceptance: Who, what, when, from which IP and app (done)
Refused attempts audited too (done)
stories.evidence: api/tests/test_clinical.py (audit of every read, write and refusal; append-only trigger)

stories.title: No clinical notes for front desk and admin
stories.want: front desk and admin to be refused clinical notes
acceptance: Tested for both roles

stories.title: Document upload
stories.want: to attach documents such as a doctor's referral
acceptance: Type and size checks; private storage; short-lived signed links

stories.title: Exercise library
stories.want: a library of exercises in French and English
acceptance: Name, description, instructions, illustration, default sets and reps

stories.title: Assign a program
stories.want: to assign a program of exercises to a patient
stories.so_that: the patient knows what to do at home
acceptance: Exercises, frequency, duration in weeks, notes

stories.title: Follow my program
stories.want: to see my program on my phone and check off each session with a pain level
acceptance: API: see my program, check off once a day with pain 0 to 10 (done)
Mobile and website screens (to do)

stories.title: Adherence chart
stories.want: to see how many sessions my patient completed
acceptance: Completed versus planned

stories.title: Daily exercise reminder
stories.want: a daily reminder on my phone
stories.so_that: I do not forget my exercises
acceptance: Configurable by the patient

stories.title: Day schedule of all therapists
stories.want: to see today's appointments of every therapist in columns, with status colours
stories.so_that: I can manage the day at a glance
acceptance: One column per therapist
Status shown by colour and in words
No clinical information

stories.title: Book for a patient on the phone
stories.want: to book, reschedule or cancel for a patient and search patients
stories.so_that: I can help patients who call
acceptance: Search by name, phone or date of birth

stories.title: Check-in and no-show
stories.want: to check patients in and mark no-shows
acceptance: No-show possible 15 minutes after the start

stories.title: Walk-in patients
stories.want: to create a patient quickly and book the next free slot

stories.title: Record payments at the desk
stories.want: to record the balance paid by cash or debit and print a receipt

stories.title: Offline mode with conflict detection
stories.want: the desktop app to keep working when the API is unreachable
stories.so_that: the desk keeps running during outages
acceptance: Encrypted read-only cache of today's schedule
Queued check-ins synchronized later, conflicts detected and reported

stories.title: Manage services, staff and rooms
stories.want: to manage services, therapists, rooms, staff accounts and roles
acceptance: Fictional licence numbers

stories.title: Reports
stories.want: weekly reports: appointments, occupancy, cancellations, no-shows, revenue

stories.title: Audit log viewer
stories.want: to search the audit log and see unusual access highlighted
acceptance: Filters by user, patient, action, date
Highlight many files read in a short time

stories.title: Privacy requests
stories.want: to handle access, correction and deletion requests within the deadline
acceptance: Health records under retention are anonymized or kept with a reason

stories.title: Confidentiality incident register
stories.want: to record confidentiality incidents
stories.so_that: the clinic meets its Law 25 obligations
acceptance: Date, description, data concerned, risk, measures, notifications

stories.title: Knowledge base management
stories.want: to upload documents and reindex the chatbot's knowledge base
acceptance: Feedback statistics

stories.title: Ask practical questions
stories.want: to ask the assistant about cancellations, insurance, parking or what to bring
stories.so_that: I get answers at any time
acceptance: Answers in French and English from the clinic's documents only
Cites the documents used
Says 'I don't know' instead of inventing

stories.title: Refuse diagnosis and handle emergencies
stories.want: the assistant to refuse diagnoses and treatment advice and to send emergencies to 911 or 811
stories.so_that: no patient is harmed by a chatbot answer
acceptance: 100% of diagnosis requests refused
Emergency messages detected
Discloses that it is an automated assistant

stories.title: Resist prompt injection and protect privacy
stories.want: the assistant to ignore instructions hidden in questions or documents and never reveal patient data
stories.so_that: it cannot be turned against the clinic
acceptance: Not connected to patient files
Personal data masked in logs, kept 30 days
Rate limited

stories.title: Measured answer quality
stories.want: the assistant's quality to be measured on a set of test questions
acceptance: 20 questions at D2, 40 with adversarial ones at D3
Hit rate, correctness, citation accuracy, refusal accuracy, latency

stories.title: Answer feedback
stories.want: to mark an answer as useful or not
stories.so_that: the clinic can improve the assistant
acceptance: Feedback stored
